from pathlib import Path
import fcntl
import importlib.util
import json

B = Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
P = B / 'main-upstream-benchsh-supervisor-source-v3'
O = B / 'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('benchsh_cpu_owner', O)
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(m)
assert m.sha(O) == 'a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'
with (B / 'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    out = B / 'main-upstream-benchsh-supervisor-cpu-root-v3'
    assert not out.exists()
    out.mkdir()
    r = dict(active=True, passed=False, complete=False, main_reviewed=True,
             gpu_executed=False, model_executed=False, commands=[], production_admitted=False)
    def save():
        (out / 'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(r, indent=2) + '\n')
    owner = m.Owner(out / 'commands', save)
    r['commands'] = owner.commands
    try:
        r['packet_pins'] = {p.name: m.sha(p) for p in P.iterdir() if p.is_file()}
        c, so, se = owner.run('benchsh-supervisor-cpu-fixtures', ['/usr/bin/python3', str(P / 'cpu-fixtures.py.txt')],
                             dict(PATH='/usr/bin:/bin', HOME='/home/yayoi', LANG='C.UTF-8', LC_ALL='C.UTF-8',
                                  PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1'), P, wall=60, cpu=180,
                             rss_cap=1 << 30, text_cap=2 << 20, total_cap=8 << 20)
        r.update(stdout=so.read_text(), stderr=se.read_text())
        assert m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] == 0
        r.update(passed=True, complete=True,
                 scope='Upstream result classification and original server close with real CPU children; no GPU/model admission')
    except BaseException as error:
        r['error'] = repr(error)
    finally:
        r.update(active=owner.active is not None, finished_utc=m.utc())
        save()
    print(json.dumps({k: r.get(k) for k in ('passed', 'error', 'stderr')}))
    raise SystemExit(0 if r['passed'] else 1)
